title: Mike Patrick with the strike force in training
description: Group photograph on the mountaintop: about a dozen Vietnamese soldiers in spotted duck-hunter camouflage — kids in training, Larry says — pose with Mike Patrick, the tall American at center with his arm around one of them. Larry thinks Patrick was a ranger with a special operations group for MACV — "what you would call a ghost or a spook." The boy at bottom right holds an M1 Garand. A second American sits on the rocks at the far right edge. Far below, the Tây Ninh plain stretches to the horizon in haze.
larrysRecollection:
Mike Patrick is the guy in the center. My father thinks he was a ranger, special operations group for MACV. He was what you would call a ghost or a spook, my father says he doesn’t know why they called him this or referred to him of this.

My father said the kid in the bottom right held a m1 grande and these kids were in training
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0010-c18035161.json). Answers the survey's open question — the tall central American is Mike Patrick, not Sgt. Lowry. 'Special operations group for MACV' maps naturally onto MACV-SOG (activated January 1964), which would fit the 'ghost'/'spook' reputation; treat as a lead for rosters, not a settled unit assignment. The seated American at the right edge is unidentified — interview goal.
